scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Substitution_Options: The recipe displays the available deterministic ingredient substitution choices.
scenarioDescriptions.Recipe_Detail_Substitution_Applied: The chosen calamansi substitution is shown on the recipe detail.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Applied_Substitution: The shopping preview identifies the selected replacement and original recipe ingredient.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Preview_Ready: A ready shopping preview shows exact required ingredient quantities without unrelated manual rows.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Unlinked_Manual_Items: An unlinked manual shopping row is shown separately and is not merged by name.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Optional_Ingredients: The user-enabled optional ingredient appears after the preview refreshes.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Line_Exact_Quantity_Edited: The shopping amount remains the exact quantity entered by the user.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Duplicate_Consolidation_Opt_In: Duplicate ingredient lines are consolidated only after explicit opt-in.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_Confirmation_Result: The server-confirmed shopping result appears after explicit confirmation.
scenarioDescriptions.Shopping_List_Updated: The shopping list contains the confirmed recipe ingredients.
